 The Inner Circle 39 And ONE Friday Fights 179 – Results And Highlights For Every Match 
 ONE Championship livened up the week with ONE SAMURAI 5, and now, the promotion’s blockbuster November 2026 event slate continues with a captivating doubleheader.
 The world’s largest martial arts organization will broadcast The Inner Circle 39 and ONE Friday Fights 179 live in Asia primetime from Bangkok’s Lumpinee Stadium on Friday, November 20.
 In the main event of The Inner Circle 39, which is available exclusively to members via live.onefc.com , ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Champion Asadula Imangazaliev will put his belt on the line against #1 contender Aslamjon Ortikov in a rematch of their June 2026 clash.
 This will also serve as a quarterfinal match in the 2026-2027 ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Grand Prix, so the winner will leave Lumpinee Stadium with 26 pounds of gold and a spot in the semifinal round.
 View this post on Instagram 
 The co-main event will also feature a quarterfinal match, as surging Thai fan favorite Black Panther will square off against undefeated British-Pakistani dynamo “Bad” Ubaid Hussain.
 Later, fans can watch ONE Friday Fights 179 through the organization’s social media platforms and global broadcast partners . Headlining that show will be a flyweight Muay Thai clash between Chartpayak Saksatoon and Klarob NuiCafeboran.
 Plus, nearly two dozen Muay Thai, MMA, and kickboxing rising stars will have a chance to earn a life-changing US$100,000 contract and coveted spot on ONE Championship’s global roster.
 For up-to-the-minute results and video highlights from every match at The Inner Circle 39 and ONE Friday Fights 179, check below.
